messages:
Ana (marketing): Quick pre-embargo check — lift Wed 11:00 PT. Need: 1-line changelog, docs anchor, RSVP link, benchmark stat for hero, and inbound routing mapping. Canary window?
Evan (eng): Canary Wed 07:00 PT -> 11:00 PT (4h). Ramp plan 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback rules: error rate >3% or sustained p95 > SLO.
Ana (marketing): Evan, short changelog blurb we can use in the announcement?
Evan (eng): "Adaptive KV caching reduces p95 token latency by ~15% on long-context workloads." Bullets: OOM fix during concurrent batching; regional fallback routing.
Cal (product): Messaging suggestion: "Faster, more predictable inference for extended conversations." Use that as the hero line.
Ruth (docs): Docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2-3-2. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2-3-2#changelog. Migration notes included.
Ana (marketing): Ruth, tiny code sample for the blog?
Ruth (docs): Inline snippet: ```
# enable adaptive cache
client.configure({"cache":"adaptive","batching":true})
```
Noor (salesops): Routing plan: Event RSVPs -> SFDC campaign "v2_3_launch_2026"; company_size>500 -> AE queue "Enterprise-West"; others -> SDR nurture. I'll push mapping and run tests.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start 1730000400, full ramp expected 1730004000. Dashboard: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/launch-172999
Evan (eng): Please avoid heavy social/press spikes first 20m post-lift — cache warmup can skew p95. We'll monitor and post a brief runbook here before canary.
Noor (salesops): Test RSVP sent with company_size=1200  verified AE queue assignment and SFDC campaign tag.
Ana (marketing): We'll stagger sends: email wave A +30m, wave B +4h; social first post +1h. Drafting announcement now, posting to #marketing-drafts in 90m for signoff. :rocket:
